verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes each NFT token serial as its permanent referral code and specifies its metadata, dashboard, and optional email presentation.
The client adds presentation of the token-serial referral code on the NFT itself while retaining metadata and dashboard display.
The client makes the mint number serving as the referral code part of the fiat buyer's confirmation email.
First concrete dashboard-path failure: the displayed referral code did not follow the expected mint-number identity sequence.
The client accepts limiting active-system NFT identities to the replacement contract and continuing its token-number sequence from #40 onward.
Distinct metadata-path failure: NFT #42 exposed the checkout referral identifier instead of its own assigned mint number.
Target-specific implementation claim after the metadata failure: the freelancer reports that Referral Code now derives from each NFT's own tokenId.
